rationale: The agent executed returns and a cancellation without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. It also canceled the entire pending order (#W2575533) instead of attempting to cancel only the hose item as requested; the user explicitly said to cancel only the hose and, if single-item cancel is not possible, to forget about it, so canceling the whole order contradicts the user’s instructions. While the agent appeared to authenticate via name/ZIP lookup and acted on the correct user, it provided refund amounts without visible supporting tool results and the final message was truncated. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
